experiments.hypothesis: A relationship-specific hook earns more owner-recorded sends and saves than a self-framed hook.
experiments.offer: Alternate a self frame and a parent frame on consecutive owner-posted features.
experiments.stopCondition: Stop if either language fails its existing editorial or sensitivity gate.

variants.description: Address the reader's own remembered childhood.
Address the remembered childhood of a parent.

experiments.hypothesis: A named family perspective produces more owner-recorded sends and saves than a generic reader perspective.
experiments.offer: Alternate self, parent and grandparent perspectives on consecutive owner-posted features.
experiments.stopCondition: Stop if a perspective invites an unsupported personal claim or weakens a sensitivity gate.

variants.description: Frame the feature around the reader's own childhood.
Frame the feature around a parent's childhood.
Frame the feature around a grandparent's childhood.

experiments.hypothesis: A family-directed close earns more owner-recorded sends and saves than a general memory question.
experiments.offer: Alternate memory-question, family-tag and product-gift framings where existing gates permit them.
experiments.stopCondition: Stop when a CTA would breach the tier-two participation ban or existing cadence guard.

variants.description: Close with one bounded memory question.
Close with the existing family-tag CTA class.
Frame the existing product-link CTA as a product gift.

experiments.hypothesis: A concise six-slide package earns more owner-recorded saves and sends than an eight-slide package.
experiments.offer: Alternate six-slide and eight-slide packages without changing the recorded brief after start.
experiments.stopCondition: Stop if either count cannot carry every cited claim without clipping or omission.

variants.description: Use a complete six-slide bilingual package.
Use a complete eight-slide bilingual package.

experiments.segment: Czech and Ukrainian readers on Threads
experiments.hypothesis: A Ukrainian-led Threads draft earns more owner-recorded sends and saves from the bilingual audience than a Czech-led draft.
experiments.offer: Alternate Ukrainian-led and Czech-led ordering on owner-posted Threads drafts.
experiments.stopCondition: Stop if either ordering drops a complete language or weakens the bilingual gate.

variants.description: Lead the bounded Threads draft in Ukrainian.
Lead the bounded Threads draft in Czech.
